title: orchis sambucina f. purpurea
intro: Orchis sambucina f. purpurea, commonly known as the purple orchid, is a subspecies of the orchid family (Orchidaceae), specifically a type of orchid found in Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antiseptic, antimicrobial, and antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Orchis sambucina f. purpurea include treating various conditions, including wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
